spans.s: विंश विंश, विंशक, &c. See below.

विंश, अस्, ई, अम्, twentieth; (अस्), m., scil. भाग,
a twentieth part (= विंशति-भाग, Manu
VIII. 398

);
(अस्), m., N. of a king.

विंश; add — accompanied or increased by twenty;
consisting of twenty parts; (अम्), n. twenty, a score.

विंशति विंशति, इस्, f. (perhaps contracted
fr. द्वि-दशति, ‘two tens’), twenty, a score; (ती), f.
du. two twenties; (तयस्), f. pl. many twenties;
[cf. Gr. εἴκατι, εἴκοαι (Lacon. βείκατι); Lat. vi-
ginti; Hib. fichead; Cambro-Brit. ugaint.]
—विं-
शतिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, worth twenty, produced
from or bought with twenty, &c.
—विंशति-तम,
अस्, ई, अम्, twentieth.
—विंशति-भाग, अस्, m. a
twentieth part.
—विंशति-वर्ष-देशीय, अस्, आ, अम्,
about twenty years old.
—विंशतीश (˚ति-ईश), अस्, or
विंशतीशिन्, ई, m. a governor of twenty villages.
विंशक, अस्, ई, अम्, twenty, an aggregate of twenty.
विंशत् in एक-व्˚, परि-व्˚, q. q. v. v.

विंशतिम, abbreviated for विंशति-तम in पञ्-
चविंशतिम, q. v.

विंशिन्, ई, m. twenty, a score; a lord of twenty
towns.
विन्द, विन्दमान, &c. See p. 925, col. 3.

विन्न, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. वित्त], known; discussed,
judged; obtained, gained; married; placed, fixed.
विन्न विन्न. See p. 919, col. 2.

विना विना, ind. (probably a kind of inst.
of 1. वि), without, except (with acc., inst., or occa-
sionally abl., e. g. भूषणम् or भूषणेन or
भूषणाद् विना, without ornament); short of, ex-
clusive of.
—विना-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘made-without,’
deprived of, bereaved, abandoned, left, relinquished.
—विनान्योन्यम् (˚ना-अन्˚), ind. without each
other, one without the other.
—विनोक्ति (˚ना-उक्˚),
इस्, f. ‘the utterance of विना,’ i. e. the use of the
word विना in composition (e. g. का निशा शशिना
विना, what is the night without the moon?).
वीना वीना, f., N. of a river.

विनङ्गृस विनङ्-गृस, अस्, m., Ved. accord-
ing to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

= कमनीयं
स्तोत्रं गृह्णाति यः; (औ), m. du. the two arms
(according to Naigh.
II. 4

विनद् वि-नद्, cl. 1. P. -नदति, -नदितुम्,
to sound forth, cry out, scream out, roar, bellow; to
thunder (as clouds); to roar or scream at (with acc.);
to fill with cries: Caus. -नादयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to sound or resound, cause to make a noise; to fill
with noise or cries; to sound aloud: Pass. of Caus.
-नाद्यते, to be made to sound, be made to cry, &c.

वि-नद, अस्, m. sound, noise; a kind of tree,
Echites Scholaris.
वि-नदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shouting, bellowing, lowing.
वि-नदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, roaring, thundering, grumbling.
वि-नादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding forth, crying out.
वि-नदी, f., N. of a river, (also read वैनदी.)
वि-नद्य, ind. having sounded, sounding.

वि-नादित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to resound, caused to
sound aloud.

वि-नाद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being made to sound
or cry.

विनन्द् वि-नन्द्, cl. 1. P. A. -नन्दति, -ते,
-नन्दितुम्, to rejoice, be glad or joyful.

विनम् वि-नम्, cl. 1. P. A. -नमति, -ते,
-नन्तुम्, to bend down, bow down, stoop: Caus.
-नमयति, -नामयति, -यितुम्, to bend down, bend
a bow; (in grammar) to cerebralize or change into
a cerebral letter.

वि-नत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent down, bowed, stooping,
inclined, sunk down, depressed, deepened; curved,
crooked; humble, modest; depressed, dispirited; (in
grammar) changed into a cerebral letter, see वि-
नाम below; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Su-dyumna;
(आ), f., N. of one of the wives of Kaśyapa and
mother of Aruṇa and Garuḍa, (in Mahā-bh. Ādi-p.
2520, Vinatā is enumerated among the thirteen
daughters of Dakṣa; the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa makes
her the wife of Tārkṣa; the Vāyu describes the
metres of the Veda as her daughters, while the Padma
gives her only one daughter, Saudāminī); a sort of
basket.
—विनत-काय, अस्, आ, अम्, having the body
bent, stooping.
—विनतानन (˚त-आन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having the face bent or cast down, dejected, dispirited.
—विनता-सूनु, उस्, m. epithet of Aruṇa (charioteer
of the Sun); of Garuḍa (younger brother of Aruṇa).
—विनतोदर (˚त-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, with bending
waist, bending at the waist.

वि-नति, इस्, f. bowing down, bending; humility,
modesty.

वि-नमन, अम्, n. the act of bending down,
bowing, bending.

वि-नमित, अस्, आ, अम्, bowed down, inclined,
declined.

वि-नम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, bent down, bowed; de-
pressed; humble, modest.

विनम्रक, अम्, n. the flower of the plant Ta-
gara.

वि-नाम, अस्, m. (in grammar) conversion into a
cerebral letter, the substitution of ष् for स् and ण्
for न्.
वि-नाम्य, ind. (fr. the Caus.), having bent down.
विनय वि-नय. See under वि-नी, p. 925.

वि-नय, अस्, m. leading, guidance, moral training,
training, discipline; gentlemanly refinement, gentle-
manlike bearing; good behaviour, propriety of con-
duct, decorum, decency; modesty, affability, humi-
lity, mildness; reverence, obeisance, courtesy; conduct
or behaviour (in general); N. of a son of Dharma;
(आ), f. the plant Sida Cordifolia; (अस्, आ, अम्), cast,
thrown; secret; a man of subdued senses; a mer-
chant, trader, (these four senses are given on the
authority of the Śabda-k.)
—विनय-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी,
इ, conforming to rules of discipline, compliant, tract-
able, humble.
—विनय-पिटक, अस्, m. ‘basket of
discipline,’ N. of those Buddhist works which contain
moral precepts and rules of discipline; [cf. त्रि-पिटक.]
—विनय-प्रधान, अस्, आ, अम्, having humility
pre-eminent, of which modesty is chief.
—विनय-
प्रमाथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, violating propriety, behaving
ill or improperly.
—विनय-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, possess-
ing propriety or modesty, well-behaved, modest.
—विनय-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing humility.
—विनय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of modesty,
well-behaved, modest.
—विनय-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, speak-
[]
ing humbly or modestly; (क्), f. modest speech.
—विनय-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, conforming to disci-
pline, compliant, tractable, governable.
—विनयाव-
नत (˚य-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, bending down modestly,
bowing low with modesty.

विनर्द् वि-नर्द्, cl. 1. P. A. -नर्दति, -ते,
-नर्दितुम्, to cry out, roar out, make a loud sound,
thunder.

वि-नर्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, crying out, making a
loud noise, sounding forth.

वि-नर्दमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding loudly,
thundering.

विनश् वि-नश्, cl. 1. 4. P. -नशति, -नश्यति,
-नशितुम्, -नंष्टुम्, to be completely lost or
ruined; to be destroyed, perish; to disappear, vanish;
to come to nothing, be frustrated: Caus. -नाशयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to be lost or ruined, destroy, anni-
hilate; to cause to disappear or vanish.

वि-नशन, अम्, n. perishing, loss, disappearance;
destruction; N. of the place where the river Sa-
rasvatī is lost in the sand; a country in the north-
west of Delhi (said to be the same as Kuru-kṣetra
or the country adjacent to the modern Paniput; see
Manu
II. 21

वि-नश्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being lost or ruined,
perishing, decaying.

वि-नश्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, liable to be destroyed,
perishable.

वि-नष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, utterly lost or ruined, dis-
appeared, perished; destroyed; spoilt, corrupted.

वि-नष्टि, इस्, f. utter loss or destruction, ruin,
disappearance.

वि-नाश, अस्, m. utter loss, annihilation, perdition,
ruin, destruction, decay, death; removal.
—विनाश-
धर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, or विनाश-धर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
subject to the law of decay.
—विनाश-सम्भव,
अस्, m. a source of destruction, cause of subsequent
non-existence of a composite body (अवयविन्).
—विनाशोन्मुख (˚श-उन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, about to
perish, verging on decay, full ripe or mature.

विनस वि-नस, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, noseless,
without a nose.

वि-नाशक, अस्, इका, अम्, annihilating, destroying;
a destroyer.
वि-नासक or वि-नासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, noseless.
वि-नाशयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, destroying, annihilating.

वि-नाशयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who destroys, a
destroyer.
वि-नाशित, अस्, आ, अम्, utterly destroyed, ruined.

वि-नाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, perishing, being destroyed; un-
dergoing transformation; destructive, destroying.

विनाडिका वि-नाडिका or वि-नाडी, f. a period
of twenty-four seconds, the sixtieth part of a Nāḍī or
Indian hour.

विनाथ वि-नाथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having no lord
or master, unprotected, unowned, deserted.
विनायक वि-नायक. See p. 925, col. 2.

वि-नायक, अस्, इका, अम्, taking away, removing;
(अस्), m. a remover (of obstacles); a Buddha or
Buddhist deified teacher; N. of the god Gaṇeśa; of
Garuḍa (the bird and vehicle of Viṣṇu); of a poet;
a Guru or spiritual preceptor; an obstacle, impedi-
ment, difficulty; (इका), f. the wife of Garuḍa.
—वि-
नायक-चरित, अम्, n., N. of the seventy-third
chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa or second part of the
Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa.
—विनायक-पण्डित, अस्, m., N.
of a poet; = नन्द-पण्डित.
—विनायक-भट्ट,
अस्, m., N. of a modern author.
—विनायक-भो-
जन-वर्णना, f., N. of a chapter of the Gaṇeśa-
Purāṇa.
—विनायकावतार-वर्णन (˚क-अव्˚),
अम्, n., N. of part of the Skanda-Purāṇa.
—विना-
यकाविर्भाव (˚क-आव्˚), अस्, m. ‘manifestation of
Gaṇeśa,’ N. of the sixth chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa
or second part of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa.
—विनायकोत्-
पत्ति (˚क-उत्˚), इस्, f. ‘birth of Gaṇeśa,’ N. of the
102nd chapter of the first part of the Liṅga-Purāṇa.

विनारुहा विनारुहा, f. a kind of plant (=
त्रि-पर्णिका).

विनाह वि-नाह, अस्, m. (see rt. 1. नह्), a
top or cover for the mouth of a well; [cf. वीनाह.]

वीनाह वीनाह, अस्, m. = वि-नाह, the top
or cover of a well.

विनिःकम्प वि-निः-कम्प, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
motionless, immovable.

विनिःश्वस् वि-निः-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति,
-श्वसितुम्, to breathe hard, sigh, heave a deep sigh.

वि-निःश्वस्य, ind. having sighed, having heaved
a sigh.

विनिःसृ वि-निः-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्,
to go forth, issue out.

वि-निःसरण, अम्, n. the act of going forth or
out, issuing forth.

वि-निःसृत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth or out, issued
forth, sprung from.

विनिकृ वि-नि-कृ (see rt. 1. कृ), cl. 8. P. A.
-करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to act badly towards,
ill-treat, offend, hurt, injure.

विनिकॄ वि-नि-कॄ (see rt. 1. कॄ), cl. 6. P.
-किरति, -करितुम् or -करीतुम्, to scatter in dif-
ferent directions, throw about; to scatter or cast
down; to scatter over, cover; to cast off, abandon.
वि-निकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, ill-treated, injured, damaged.

वि-निकृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut or hewn in pieces,
mutilated.

विनिकृत् वि-नि-कृत् (see rt. 2. कृत्), cl. 6. P.
-कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut or hew in pieces, cut
off, cut away, cut about, mutilate; to tear off; to
destroy.

वि-निकृत्य, ind. having cut away or asunder,
having destroyed, having dissipated.

वि-निकीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, scattered over, covered;
spread over; crowded, filled; outstretched; dispersed.

विनिक्ष् वि-निक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -निक्षति, &c.
(Ved. Inf. विनिक्षे), to pierce, penetrate.

वि-निक्षण, अम्, n. the act of piercing; [cf.
Nirukta
IV. 18

विनिक्षिप् वि-नि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षि-
पति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw or cast down, over-
throw; to put or place down; to put or place in or
on, infix, insert; to deposit, deliver over, entrust
with; to occupy with or engage in.

वि-निक्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or tossed down;
fixed, infixed, inserted; deposited; dispatched, sent.

वि-निक्षिप्य, ind. having thrown or flung down,
having put down, having delivered over, having given
into charge.

वि-निक्षेप, अस्, m. the act of throwing or tossing
down, sending.

विनिगड वि-निगड, अस्, आ, अम्, fetterless,
without fetters.
—विनिगडी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति,
-कर्तुम्, to render fetterless, unfetter, unshackle.

विनिगद् वि-नि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, -गदि-
तुम्, to speak to, address, accost: Pass. -गद्यते,
to be called or named.

विनिगुह् वि-नि-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति,
-ते, -गूहितुम् or -गोढुम्, to cover over, conceal,
hide.
वि-निगूहित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, concealed, hidden.

विनिग्रह् वि-नि-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति,
गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to lay hold of, seize; to hold in,
keep back, keep in check, restrain, obstruct, impede.
वि-निगृह्य, ind. having seized, having restrained.

वि-निग्रह, अस्, m. restraining, subduing, restraint;
disjunction, mutual opposition, an antithesis which im-
plies that when two propositions are antithetically stated
peculiar stress is laid on one of them.
—विनिग्र-
हार्थ (˚ह-अर्˚), अस्, m. the sense of the above
antithesis.
—विनिग्रहार्थीय, अस्, आ, अम्, standing
in the sense of the above antithesis.
विनिघ्नत् वि-निघ्नत्. See under वि-नि-हन्.

वि-निघ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, striking down, wound-
ing; killing.

विनिचूर्ण् वि-नि-चूर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -चूर्णयति,
-यितुम्, to grind or crush to pieces, pulverize, pound,
rub.

विनिद्र वि-निद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, sleepless, awake;
blown, budded.
—विनिद्र-करण, अम्, n. rendering
sleepless.
—विनिद्र-ता, f. or विनिद्र-त्व, अम्, n.
sleeplessness, wakefulness, vigilance, waking.

विनिधा वि-नि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति,
-धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put or lay down in different
[]
places, distribute; to put off; to lay or put down;
to put away; to place or put on; to put by, lay aside,
store up; to fix upon, direct, (with दृष्टिम्, &c.,
to fix the eyes upon; with मनस्, &c., to fix or
direct the mind upon; with हृदि or हृदये, to fix
in the heart, keep fixed in the heart, bear in mind.)

वि-निधाय, ind. having put in different places,
having distributed; having placed or taken, &c.

वि-निहित, अस्, आ, अम्, put off or down, &c.; fixed
on, directed.
—विनिहित-दृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, having
the eyes fixed upon, eagerly looking at, intent on.
—विनिहित-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the mind
fixed upon, intent upon, devoted to.

विनिध्वंस् वि-नि-ध्वंस् or वि-नि-ध्वस्, cl.
1. A. -ध्वंसते, -ध्वंसितुम्, to fall to pieces, be
dispersed, be destroyed, perish, disappear, vanish; (2nd
sing. Impv. विनिध्वंस, be off! take thyself off!)

वि-निध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, ruined, struck
down.

विनिन्द् वि-निन्द्, cl. 1. P. -निन्दति (ep. also
A. -ते), -निन्दितुम्, to reproach, revile, abuse.

विनिपट् वि-नि-पट्, cl. 10. P. -पाटयति, &c.,
to split open, split up, cleave.
वि-निपाट्य, ind. having split open, having severed.

विनिपत् वि-नि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पति-
तुम्, to fall down, fall headlong, fall in or into; fall
upon, attack, assail; fly down, fly away: Caus. -पा-
तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall down, throw down;
to kill, deprive of life; to destroy, annihilate: Pass.
of Caus. -पात्यते, to be thrown down.

वि-निपतित, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen down; flown down;
flying away.

वि-निपातित, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown down; killed,
destroyed.
वि-निपत्य, ind. having fallen down, &c.
वि-निपात्य, ind. having killed.

वि-निपात, अस्, m. falling down, falling; a great
fall, ruin, any great calamity or unavoidable evil;
decay, death, destruction; pain, distress; disrespect.
—विनिपात-शंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, announcing misfortune
or destruction, portentous.

विनिमज्ज् वि-नि-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति,
&c., to plunge in or under, dive under, bathe.

वि-निमग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged, bathed, im-
mersed.

विनिमील् वि-नि-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, -मी-
लितुम्, to close the eyes, wink, connive; to close or
shut (as the eyes &c.).

वि-निमीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, closed, shut (as the eyes
&c.).
—विनिमीलितेक्षण (˚त-ईक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having the eyes closed.

विनिमे वि-नि-मे, cl. 1. A. -मयते, -मातुम्,
to exchange, barter.

वि-निमय, अस्, m. exchange, barter, (विनिम-
येन, alternately); a pledge, deposit, security; trans-

तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.

of Viṣṇu.

), referred by some to rt. विध् or व्यध्,

VI. 18

विन्धपत्त्र विन्ध-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a plant
(commonly called Bel Suṇṭh).

विन्ध्य विन्ध्य, अस्, m. (perhaps connected
with rt. बिन्द् or बिद्, ‘to divide’), N. of a range of
mountains connecting the Northern extremities of
the Western and Eastern Ghauts, and separating Hin-
dūstān proper from the Dekhan, (the Vindhya range
is reckoned among the seven principal mountains of
Bhārata-varṣa [see कुलाचल, p. 240, col. 3], and
according to Manu
II. 21

. forms the Southern limit
of Madhya-deśa or the middle region, regarded as
the sacred land of the Hindūs; according to a legend
related in the Vana-parvan of the Mahā-bhārata,
1. 8782 &c., the personified Vindhya mountain,
jealous of Himālaya, demanded that the sun should
revolve round him in the same way as about Meru,
which the sun declining to do, the Vindhya then began
to elevate himself that he might bar the progress of
both sun and moon; the gods alarmed, asked the
aid of the saint Agastya, who approached the moun-
tain and requested that by bending down he would
afford him an easy passage to the South country,
begging at the same time that he would retain a low
position till his return; this the mountain promised
to do, but Agastya never returned, and the Vindhya
range consequently never attained the elevation of
the Himālaya); a hunter; (आ), f. a kind of plant
or tree (= लवली); small cardamoms (= त्रुटि).
